name: geoedit
description: GeoPBF topological editor as a map gadget: initEditor(map, opts). Edits on the sphere (great-circle edges, rotations, small circles), @style annotations shared with the viewer (geopbf/edit/draw), large-file mode on GintBUF — the editor half of the geopbf format. MIT.
author: Kenji Yoshida <kenji.yoshida.home.2026@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run i18n:build
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run i18n:check
scripts.test: npm run i18n:check && npm run -w @ortho-earth/japan verify:editor
scripts.mirror: git -C ../.. subtree split --prefix=packages/geoedit -b geoedit-mirror && git -C ../.. push https://github.com/kenjiyoshidahome2026-bit/geoedit.git geoedit-mirror:main --force && git -C ../.. branch -D geoedit-mirror
